'''Che Amanwe Papanoida''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was the daughter of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora's]] [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]], [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]]. She, along with her sister [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]], were kidnapped by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. During the Clone Wars she lived with her sister in an expensive apartment, which was notably decorated with plants and idols of Pantoran origin.

==Biography==
[[File:CheAmanweBadass-SoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Che Amanwe uses an appropriated blaster to defend her family]]
Che and her sister Chi were present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when their father and Senator [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] were trying to petition the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] into ending the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockade]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. In the middle of the night, the sisters were kidnapped by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] on behalf of the Separatists, but not before Che was able to hit the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with an idol, which her father realized was misplaced. Che was separated from her sister and was held captive in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] while Chi was placed in the [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)/Legends|Trade Federation ship]] in orbit of Pantora. Che's father and her brother [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion]] were able to track Greedo down by using the blood sample on the idol, before gaining [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] assistance. However, Che accidentally identified her father to Greedo's associates upon seeing him, causing a firefight to ensue. Che saved her father when Greedo's [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter/Legends|accomplice]] was going to shoot him. The Papanoidas were soon reunited and returned to Coruscant as the Trade Federation lifted the blockade.

==Behind the scenes==
Che Amanwe Papanoida is based on [[George Lucas]]' daughter, [[Amanda Lucas]] and voiced by [[Meredith Salenger]].<ref name="Episode Guide" />
